newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's Belle dips 3.17 pct in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Manila's Belle dips 3.17 pct in late trade.

text.p: The Philippines' Belle Corp shed 20 centavos, or 3.17 percent, to 6.10 pesos in late trade on Friday, dragged down by the general market fall and lingering concerns over the property sector, brokers said.
Belle has interests in gaming and property.

"Most of its revenues for the year are from its property business. It is being affected by perception, but there is nothing to worry about since they have buyers for their projects and often they have to draw lots for reservations," said Alexis Cabel, analyst at Angping & Associates Securities.
"The issue is being sold down as part of the general selling pressure," said Allan Araullo, vice-president at Regina Capital Development Corp.
Belle was the most heavily traded with turnover of 125 million pesos late in the session.
